title: PAP Supply Replenishment Program Shipping Rate Card
content:
Shipping under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program is set per resupply schedule by six figures: the ground shipping charge, the self-pay order value at or above which ground shipping is free, the patient-paid expedited charge (never billed to coverage), the business days ground and expedited shipping take, and whether the patient may collect the shipment at a branch.

| Schedule | Ground shipping fee (USD) | Self-pay free-shipping minimum (USD) | Expedited shipping fee (USD) | Ground transit | Expedited transit | Branch pickup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Resupply Schedule | 0.00 | 0.00 | 14.95 | 5 business days | 2 business days | allowed |
| Medicare Advantage Resupply Schedule | 0.00 | 0.00 | 14.95 | 5 business days | 2 business days | allowed |
| Medicaid Resupply Schedule | 0.00 | 0.00 | 14.95 | 5 business days | 2 business days | allowed |
| Commercial HMO Resupply Schedule | 0.00 | 0.00 | 14.95 | 5 business days | 2 business days | allowed |
| Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule | 0.00 | 0.00 | 14.95 | 5 business days | 2 business days | allowed |
| Self-Pay Supply Subscription | 6.95 | 75.00 | 14.95 | 5 business days | 2 business days | allowed |

A free-shipping minimum of 0.00 means that ground shipping is always free on that schedule.

## Reading the card

- The Self-Pay Supply Subscription is the only schedule with a ground shipping fee, 6.95, and the only one with a free-shipping minimum above 0.00, 75.00.
- The expedited fee, 14.95, is the same on every schedule and is patient-paid, never billed to coverage.
- Ground shipping takes 5 business days and expedited shipping 2 business days on every schedule, and branch pickup is allowed on every schedule.
